instruction:
Extend the shared all-day draft-creation hook with an OPT-IN multi-day drag gesture.

Read .sdlc/runs/20260820-004405-feature-extend-allday-multiday-drag/change_plan.md FIRST. Sections 10 and 11 are orchestrator corrections that OVERRIDE section 4 — obey them. Do not read other .sdlc files. Section 2 gives the exact option/return types, section 4 the lifecycle, section 5 the preview/commit calls, section 10 the CORRECTED commit timing, section 11 the approved click-timing consequence and its required test case. Mirror the gesture mechanics in packages/web/src/grid/hooks/useTimedDraftCreation.ts (read it; do NOT edit it).

WRITE EXACTLY TWO FILES:
1. packages/web/src/grid/hooks/useAllDayDraftCreation.ts (edit)
2. packages/web/src/grid/hooks/useAllDayDraftCreation.test.tsx (edit — keep all three existing tests passing unchanged in intent)

THE CONTRACT, precisely:
- Add optional visibleBounds?: { minDate: string; maxDate: string } to the options. The hook still RETURNS the same bare handler (event, calendarId?) => void. Do not change the return shape — both call sites destructure nothing.
- WITHOUT visibleBounds: run the current body verbatim (right-click ignore, preventDefault/stopPropagation, isDrafting discard, resolve one date, +1 day, createGridEventDraft, onCreateGridDraft ?? onCreateDraft) and return. Attach NO window listeners. This is Day view's path and must be byte-for-byte behaviourally identical to today.
- WITH visibleBounds (Week): on mousedown publish the single-day draft immediately via draftActions.startGridDraft({ activity: "creating", draft }) — per section 10 this is what keeps the existing mousedown-only assertion in MainGrid.test.tsx green — then attach window mousemove/mouseup/blur/keydown listeners (capture where useTimedDraftCreation uses capture). Past TIMED_DRAFT_CREATE_MOVE_THRESHOLD_PX (4px), recompute via calculateAllDayCreateSchedule from @web/grid/interaction/math/all-day.create and draftActions.setGridDraft(replaceGridDraftSchedule(...)). On mouseup call onCreateGridDraft(finalDraft) exactly once. On Escape keydown or window blur call draftActions.discard() and commit nothing. Clean up every listener on finish, cancel and unmount (useEffect cleanup + gestureRef, as the timed hook does).

NEW TEST CASES REQUIRED (section 7 item 2 plus section 11): sub-threshold click; left-to-right drag; right-to-left drag normalizing to the same span; Escape cancels with no commit; blur cancels with no commit; opt-out path commits on mousedown and attaches no listeners; and the section-11 case — opted-in mousedown with NO mouseup leaves the store draft at activity "creating", then mouseup fires onCreateGridDraft exactly once.

HARD LIMITS: write ONLY the files listed below. Do not touch packages/web/src/views/Day/**, packages/web/src/grid/hooks/useTimedDraftCreation.ts, packages/web/src/views/Week/hooks/grid/useTimedGridDraftCreation.ts, MainGrid.test.tsx, or anything under packages/backend|sync|core|scripts. Do not run the test suite (the orchestrator runs it). Match the surrounding code style exactly: bun:test, named exports, import aliases (@core, @web), and the repo's alphabetised import order.
acceptance: visibleBounds is optional; omitting it runs the pre-existing synchronous mousedown-commit body and attaches no window listeners
Hook still returns the bare (event, calendarId?) => void handler — no change to the return shape
Opted-in mousedown publishes the single-day draft with activity 'creating' before any mouseup
onCreateGridDraft is called exactly once per gesture, on mouseup
Escape keydown and window blur both discard without committing
All listeners removed on finish, cancel and unmount
The three pre-existing tests in useAllDayDraftCreation.test.tsx still pass unmodified in intent
New cases cover: sub-threshold click, LTR drag, RTL drag normalization, Escape, blur, opt-out path, and the activity-'creating'-on-mousedown case
Exactly two files modified
